import struct,sys
ISO='/app/alpine.iso'
f=open(ISO,'rb')
SS=2048
def rd(lba,n):
    f.seek(lba*SS); return f.read(n)
# find PVD
pvd=None
for lba in range(16,16+32):
    v=rd(lba,SS)
    if v[0]==1 and v[1:6]==b'CD001':
        pvd=v; break
    if v[0]==255: break
assert pvd
root=pvd[156:156+34]
root_lba=struct.unpack('<I',root[2:6])[0]
root_size=struct.unpack('<I',root[10:14])[0]
print('root',root_lba,root_size,file=sys.stderr)
def parse_su(su,names):
    i=0
    while i+4<=len(su):
        sig=su[i:i+2]; ln=su[i+2]
        if ln<4: break
        if sig==b'NM' and ln>=5:
            flags=su[i+4]
            nm=su[i+5:i+ln]
            if not (flags&2):
                names.append(nm.decode('utf-8','replace'))
        if sig==b'ST': break
        i+=ln
def listdir(lba,size,path,depth,out):
    data=rd(lba,size)
    off=0
    entries=[]
    while off<len(data):
        l=data[off]
        if l==0:
            off=(off//SS+1)*SS
            continue
        rec=data[off:off+l]
        ext=struct.unpack('<I',rec[2:6])[0]
        dlen=struct.unpack('<I',rec[10:14])[0]
        flags=rec[25]
        nlen=rec[32]
        name=rec[33:33+nlen]
        su_start=33+nlen
        if su_start%2: su_start+=1
        su=rec[su_start:l]
        names=[]
        parse_su(su,names)
        if name==b'\x00': nm='.'
        elif name==b'\x01': nm='..'
        else:
            nm=name.decode('ascii','replace')
            if ';' in nm: nm=nm.split(';')[0]
            if names: nm=names[0]
        isdir=bool(flags&2)
        entries.append((nm,ext,dlen,isdir))
        off+=l
    for nm,ext,dlen,isdir in entries:
        if nm in ('.','..'): continue
        full=path+'/'+nm
        print(('D' if isdir else 'F'),ext,dlen,full)
        out.append((full,ext,dlen,isdir))
        if isdir and depth>0:
            listdir(ext,dlen,full,depth-1,out)
out=[]
listdir(root_lba,root_size,'',4,out)
PY

            names.append(su[i+5:i+ln].decode('utf-8','replace'))
        if sig==b'ST': break
        i+=ln
    return names
def walk(lba,size,path,entries):

import socket,time,sys
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_STREAM); s.connect('/tmp/alpine.serial'); s.settimeout(0.5)
end=time.time()+float(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 5)
out=b''
while time.time()<end:
    try:
        d=s.recv(65536)
        if not d: break
        out+=d
    except socket.timeout: pass
sys.stdout.buffer.write(out)
